data.long_description:
Bay Grove Residences Phase 2 by Nakheel is an exclusive waterfront enclave within the iconic Dubai Islands masterplan. Designed as a private gated community, it blends contemporary architecture with a refined, resort-inspired lifestyle—offering residents uninterrupted full sea views, elevated green landscapes, and direct access to the pristine Crystal Beach.

This top corner unit is truly exceptional, providing unmatched privacy, abundant natural light, and sweeping panoramic views across both the marina and the open sea. Perfectly positioned on Marina Island, it delivers a serene coastal setting while maintaining convenient access to Dubai’s historic destinations via the Infinity Bridge.

Key Features:

Exclusive waterfront community developed by Nakheel
Full sea view top corner unit offering maximum privacy
Direct Crystal Beach access
Elevated podium gardens and beautifully landscaped surroundings
Signature community clubhouse with shaded family areas
Secure 24/7 gated community

Location & Connectivity:

10 mins – Dubai Frame
20 mins – Downtown Dubai (Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall)
20 mins – Dubai Marina
25 mins – Dubai International Airport (DXB)

World-Class Amenities:

Indoor and outdoor swimming pools
Private residents’ cinema
Gaming lounge and modern co-working spaces
Fully equipped gymnasium and yoga studio
Concierge services and elegant lounge areas
Children’s pool and shaded play zones
Family-friendly restaurants and cafés
Landscaped gardens and podium relaxation decks
Central air conditioning & CCTV security
